high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the account "screenrant," which has a verified badge. The tweet was posted 5 hours ago. The content of the tweet is a quote attributed to director Chad Stahelski about the creation of the John Wick universe. The quote reads: "We came up with the idea that there's a Continental in every city. Derek had come up with the idea of markers. Then I was like... 'let's go full Lord of the Rings, and we're going to make a fantasy world here and that's how we'll start modeling it...' - director Chad Stahelski."
